answer: In an agent market trading pigment, reef-monitoring data, and ferrous scrap, each seller must lock a separate bond for every active contract. The contract slashes that bond if the seller fails to post the agreed deliverable by its on-chain deadline. Creating identities cannot multiply unbonded selling capacity: an attacker running 1,000 simultaneous fake sellers must lock 1,000 bonds and forfeits a bond for each missed delivery.
